# SnapOtter

Open-source, self-hostable file manipulation suite with 157 tools across 5 modalities (image, video, audio, PDF, and data) plus a layer-based image editor. Self-hosted as a small Docker Compose stack (app + Postgres 17 + Redis 8), no external SaaS dependencies. Dual-licensed AGPLv3 and commercial.

All processing happens on your own infrastructure -- files never leave your network. Image tools support 55+ input formats (including 23 camera RAW formats); video and audio run through a bundled static FFmpeg; PDFs and office documents use qpdf, pdfcpu, Ghostscript, and LibreOffice. Local AI features (background removal, upscaling, OCR, transcription, and more) download on demand and run on your hardware, GPU-optional.

## Quick Start (Docker Compose)

SnapOtter runs as three containers: the app, Postgres 17, and Redis 8. Save this as docker-compose.yml and run `docker compose up -d`:

```yaml
services:
  snapotter:
    image: snapotter/snapotter:latest
    ports: ["1349:1349"]
    environment:
      - DEFAULT_USERNAME=admin
      - DEFAULT_PASSWORD=admin            # change on first login
      - DATABASE_URL=postgres://snapotter:snapotter@postgres:5432/snapotter
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
    volumes: ["snapotter-data:/data"]
    depends_on:
      postgres: { condition: service_healthy }
      redis: { condition: service_healthy }
    restart: unless-stopped
  postgres:
    image: postgres:17-alpine
    environment: { POSTGRES_USER: snapotter, POSTGRES_PASSWORD: snapotter, POSTGRES_DB: snapotter }
    volumes: ["snapotter-pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data"]
    healthcheck: { test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U snapotter"], interval: 10s, retries: 12 }
    restart: unless-stopped
  redis:
    image: redis:8-alpine
    command: ["redis-server", "--maxmemory-policy", "noeviction", "--appendonly", "yes"]
    volumes: ["snapotter-redisdata:/data"]
    healthcheck: { test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"], interval: 10s, retries: 12 }
    restart: unless-stopped
volumes:
  snapotter-data:
  snapotter-pgdata:
  snapotter-redisdata:
```

Default credentials: admin / admin (must change on first login).
GPU acceleration: use docker-compose-gpu.yml (NVIDIA Container Toolkit required; falls back to CPU).
Multi-arch: AMD64 and ARM64 (Intel, Apple Silicon, Raspberry Pi).
Upgrading from 1.x (SQLite): set SQLITE_MIGRATE_PATH=/data/snapotter.db on first boot to import the old database.

## Tools by Modality

157 tools total. Full catalog at https://snapotter.com/tools and via the API. Highlights:

### Image (64 tools)
resize, crop, rotate, convert, compress, optimize-for-web, strip-metadata, adjust-colors, sharpening, watermark-text, watermark-image, collage, beautify, meme-generator, vectorize, favicon, color-palette, find-duplicates, qr-generate, barcode-read, html-to-image, image-to-pdf, and more.

### Video (29 tools)
convert-video, compress-video, trim-video, resize-video, crop-video, rotate-video, video-speed, change-fps, stabilize-video, mute-video, video-to-gif, watermark-video, video-color, aspect-pad, and more.

### Audio (17 tools)
convert-audio, trim-audio, merge-audio, split-audio, volume-adjust, normalize-audio, fade-audio, audio-speed, pitch-shift, audio-channels, silence-removal, noise-reduction, ringtone-maker, waveform-image, and more.

### PDF & documents (37 tools)
merge-pdf, split-pdf, compress-pdf, rotate-pdf, protect-pdf, unlock-pdf, organize-pdf, extract-pages, remove-pages, repair-pdf, linearize-pdf, word-to-pdf, excel-to-pdf, convert-presentation, convert-document, pdf-to-image, and more.

### Data (10 tools)
csv-excel, csv-json, json-xml, yaml-json, xml-to-csv, split-csv, merge-csvs, chart-maker, create-zip, extract-zip.

### Local AI (19 tools, on-demand model bundles)
remove-background (rembg), upscale (RealESRGAN), erase-object (LaMa), ocr and ocr-pdf (PaddleOCR, 80+ languages), blur-faces, smart-crop, enhance-faces, colorize, noise-removal, red-eye-removal, restore-photo, passport-photo, transparency-fixer, ai-canvas-expand (outpainting), background-replace, blur-background, transcribe-audio and auto-subtitles (faster-whisper). Models download on demand; CPU or NVIDIA GPU.

## REST API

Base URL: http://localhost:1349/api/v1
Interactive docs: http://localhost:1349/api/docs (Scalar UI)
Machine-readable spec: http://localhost:1349/api/docs/json (OpenAPI 3.1)
LLM-optimized API spec: http://localhost:1349/llms.txt (generated from OpenAPI at runtime)
Full plain-text API docs: http://localhost:1349/llms-full.txt

Authentication:
- Session cookie (browser login)
- Bearer token: Authorization: Bearer si_<key> (API keys are prefixed si_)

Role-based access with 3 built-in roles (admin, editor, user) and 17 granular permissions, plus custom roles. API keys support scoped permissions that intersect with the user's role permissions.

Processing a file:
  POST /api/v1/tools/:toolId
  Content-Type: multipart/form-data
  Body: file (binary), settings (JSON string)
  Fast tools respond 200 { jobId, downloadUrl, originalSize, processedSize }.
  Long-running and AI tools respond 202 { jobId, async: true } and stream progress via SSE:
  GET /api/v1/jobs/:jobId/progress (EventSource)

Pipelines (chained tool workflows):
  POST /api/v1/pipeline/execute
  POST /api/v1/pipeline/save
  GET /api/v1/pipeline/list
  DELETE /api/v1/pipeline/:id
  POST /api/v1/pipeline/batch

Batch processing: POST /api/v1/tools/:toolId/batch (multiple files in, ZIP archive out).

## Tech Stack

Frontend: React 19, Vite 6, Tailwind CSS 4, Zustand, Konva (image editor)
Backend: Fastify 5, Sharp (images), Postgres 17 via Drizzle ORM, Redis 8 + BullMQ (durable job queues)
Media & docs: static FFmpeg (video/audio), qpdf, pdfcpu, Ghostscript, LibreOffice, pandoc, WeasyPrint (PDF & documents)
AI/ML: Python sidecar (rembg, RealESRGAN, PaddleOCR, faster-whisper, MediaPipe, LaMa) via on-demand bundle install
Auth: Session-based with OIDC/SSO support (Google, GitHub, Okta, any OIDC provider)
Languages: 21 locales with RTL support

## Key Features

- 157 tools across image, video, audio, PDF, and data, plus a layer-based image editor
- Pipelines: chain tools into reusable workflows, import/export as JSON
- Batch processing: process many files at once, download as a ZIP
- Local AI: background removal, upscaling, OCR, transcription, colorization, restoration -- all on your hardware
- OIDC/SSO and role-based access (admin, editor, user) with 17 granular permissions, custom roles, and API key scoping
- Self-hosted: 3-container Docker Compose stack, multi-arch (AMD64/ARM64), GPU-optional
